meta.subtitle: the host's win brings Wins to 100 · the observer on another ingress gets WinMilestoneNotify

cards.title: Subscribe then publish
items: Observer Play = Observer Play Session; Host Play = Host Play Session; Entry Spot = Play Entry Spot.
The fake user source gives the host Wins=99; the host's win in this game brings it to 100.
R computes Wins=100 (mermaid self-step), then publishes PlayerWinMilestoneEvent to a subscribed Entry Spot.

cards.title: Publish is not the result
items: Multicast publish completion doesn't mean the subscriber handler finished or the win is confirmed.
The Room Spot decides the win and board state; the milestone only announces an already-decided value.
